Rachel, saw Qualia added Customers Bank and Axos Bank to its Bank Partner Network early this year.

Network expansion like that surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can route and touch in time, and the slow handoff from signal to first touch is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Qualia off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Rachel, quick follow-up for Qualia.

Most RevOps teams surface intent just fine, the latency is in turning a signal into a personalized first touch before it goes stale. That lag quietly caps how much of your pipeline ever gets worked, regardless of how clean the data is.

I can walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I'd change to cut signal-to-action time. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70%. Want to grab 15 minutes?

Rachel, last bit of proof for Qualia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Qualia's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Qualia either way.
